title: 巴陵夜别王八员外
author: 贾至
subtitle: 【唐人万首绝句选】唐·贾至
baihua_lines: 柳絮飞时别洛阳，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: Through the passing hours, age creeps upon me unawares while she remember all around.
As the traveler wander through the path ahead, peach petals drift.
It is the time when heavy storm clouds gather, and you ponder on in quiet thought.
The poet cannot help but pause, for you journey to a distant place.
